column1: RT02 – Regression: Add Product to Cart (Jira‑Ready Format)
column29:
*Reason for Regression:*   BUG01 (Cart count not updating) has been fixed. We must ensure the fix did not break existing cart functionality.

*Precondition:*

* User is logged in
* Product is available in stock

*Regression Test Steps:*

# Navigate to product listing
# Select a product
# Click “Add to Cart”
# Verify cart count updates
# Add another product
# Verify cart count updates again
# Refresh the page
# Verify cart count persists
# Navigate to Cart page
# Verify both products are listed correctly

*Expected Result:*

* Cart count updates correctly
* Products appear in cart
* No new issues introduced after the fix

*Labels:*   regression, ecommerce, cart

*Priority:* High

column1: RT03 – Regression: Checkout Flow After Payment Fix
column29:
*Reason for Regression:*   BUG02 (Payment fails with valid card) has been fixed. We must ensure checkout and payment flow still works correctly and no new issues appear.

*Precondition:*

* Cart contains at least one product
* User has valid payment details

*Regression Test Steps:*

# Go to Checkout
# Enter valid card details
# Click “Pay Now”
# Verify payment succeeds
# Verify order confirmation page appears
# Verify order ID is generated
# Navigate to Order History
# Verify the new order appears in the list
# Refresh Order History
# Verify order still appears correctly

*Expected Result:*

* Payment succeeds
* Order confirmation is displayed
* Order appears in Order History
* No new issues introduced after the fix

*Labels:*   regression, ecommerce, checkout, payment

*Priority:* High
